method: Visual comparison of the original PDF page (rendered with pdfplumber/pypdfium2 from rag/corpus_v3/pdf, read-only) against every extracted cleaned row of the table. Sample: reproducible and stratified - the table with the most numeric values in each non-staff category, plus specific edge cases (wrap repair, glued values, most duplicate rows, split rows) and 4 pages flagged by the missed-table detector. Staff tables were excluded (personal data). Verdicts: verified = rows and cells faithful to the page with usable column semantics; needs_review = values faithful but a structural issue limits structured use; unusable_for_structured_queries = wrong, lost or semantically unusable cells.

40025990:t00401.notes: All 3 activity rows: estimated (290,000,000.00 / 8,809,012.23 / 76,241,411.73) and actual amounts, review type, method, market approach, status and all planned/actual stage dates match the page; typed activities match; 0.00 actual kept as zero. Wrapped amounts (140,348,30|8.59) correctly re-joined. Issue: stage-date keys in typed activities keep word breaks ('Contract Complet ion').

40025990:t00201.notes: Cell values match the page (Summary of the ICB (Works) 290 / 1 / No / Prior). Continuation of t00102 detected, but the header at the bottom of page 1 (narrow wrapped columns: Estimated Cost US$ million, No. of contracts, Domestic Preference, Review by Bank) was not recognised: all 7 columns col_n, unit lost.

40089196:t00301.notes: Every value matches the page (e.g. Roads constructed 0.00 May/2015, 56 30-Jul-2025, 57.40 25-Feb-2026, target 57.40 Jun/2026; blanks stay blank). Two-level header: the Value/Month-Year sub-header row is stored as a data row. Last indicator row split across pages 3-4 (name fragment, unit on next page).

40089196:t00501.notes: Row 1 'Key operational units ... (Yes/No)' shows No | Yes | Yes | Yes on the page, but all value cells are empty in the extraction: pdfplumber detected only the first-column cell for that row (no top border on the continuation part), so the values were lost silently. Other rows match (0.00 / 270 / 270.00; 0.00 / 3,000 / 2,000 / 2,000.00).

33851641:t00701.notes: Older (2022) ISR results layout: each printed line captured as a single cell ('Value 0.00 -- 0.00 3,000.00'), internal indicator IDs as rows; the results framework on pages 3-6 was not detected as tables at all.

24440102:t02201.notes: Table 1 Project Cost and Financing (US$ million): the 3 components, totals, front-end fees and total financing collapsed into ONE data row; stacked values glued without separators ('340.0018.0012.00370.000.00370.00', '1001001001000100'). Totals not distinguished.

24440102:t11501.notes: Table 5.6 Cost Estimate of the Proposed Options (US$/km): values correct, but 3 option sub-tables stacked in one 16-column grid, real headers stored as data rows, row-spanning weighted-average values attached to the first lot only, design-fee/total rows mixed with lots.

26256705:t07001.notes: Table 5.4 Base Year Traffic (ADT/year): all 13x9 cells match; em-dashes kept as '—' (not zero); unit in caption. Total row stored as an ordinary row (not flagged).

34455066:t04502.notes: Table 4 Sampled Projects: all values match (e.g. Dilla 44/5/1/117/3/2; Total 135/19/19/25/270...). Vertical (rotated) column headers extracted REVERSED ('eganiarD' = Drainage, 'sdaoR' = Roads): column semantics unusable until repaired. Total row not flagged.

34455066:t03101.notes: Hierarchical DLI block: values match (0.00 / 14,960,000.00 ...), but repeated row labels (Allocated Amount, Actual Value ...) are meaningless without the parent DLI, DLI titles split over 3 rows, columns col_n, currency not stated. The automated 'duplicate rows' are legitimate repeated labels, not extraction duplicates.

34455066:t01401.notes: Table 2 Summary of Achievement of Each Indicator: every row matches, columns labelled (Performance Indicators / Baseline / Target / Result / Achievement). Typing needs unit/scale parsing ('6.6 million', '50%', '1500' vs '1,600'); units only inside indicator text; one unrepaired break ('E xceeded').

34407877:t01401.notes: Ratings text layout: header detection swallowed a whole paragraph as a column name; internal template marker rows ('OBJR1_TBL') and empty rows. Suitable for semantic retrieval only.

33851641:3.notes: Results framework (per-indicator blocks: Baseline / Actual (Previous) / Actual (Current) / End Target, Value and Date rows, '--' = not available) not extracted. Pages 4-6 flagged automatically with the same template (not visually verified).
